checks.name: Install + Initialize
checks.evidence: Server starts and responds to initialize. baozi-mcp v2.0.0, protocol 2024-11-05.

checks.name: List Tools
checks.evidence: 76 tools with names, descriptions, and JSON schemas. Categories: markets, quotes, transactions, positions, affiliates, intel, arena.

checks.name: Auth
checks.evidence: Wallet-authenticated call succeeds. Shows 1 active position on mainnet-beta.

checks.name: Balance
checks.evidence: No dedicated SOL balance tool. get_claimable returns platform balance. get_positions returns bet amounts. Native SOL balance requires direct RPC.

checks.name: List Markets
checks.evidence: 86 total markets. 15 Active, 3 with betting open. Markets include IDs, public keys, questions, status, pool sizes, odds.

checks.name: Market Detail
checks.output: {"success":true,"market":{"marketId":"90","question":"Will the SEC approve a prediction market ETF before Jun 30, 2026?","yesPoolSol":0.02,"noPoolSol":0.02,"totalPoolSol":0.04,"platformFeeBps":300}}

checks.name: Pricing Quality
checks.evidence: Pari-mutuel pricing with expected payout, profit, implied odds, decimal odds, fees, and pool shift projections.

checks.name: Search
checks.evidence: list_markets only supports status and layer filters. No keyword/text/category search. Agent must list all and filter client-side.

checks.name: Schema Consistency
checks.output: All 3 markets: 22 identical fields, Schema consistent: True
checks.evidence: Identical 22-field schemas across all markets: accessGate, closingTime, creator, creatorFeeBps, currencyType, hasBets, isBettingOpen, layer, layerCode, marketId, noPercent, noPoolSol, platformFeeBps, publicKey, question, resolutionTime, status, statusCode, totalPoolSol, winningOutcome, yesPercent, yesPoolSol.

checks.name: Preview/Dry-Run
checks.evidence: Two preview tools: get_quote (pricing) and validate_bet (full validation + quote). Both return expected payout, odds, fees without executing.

checks.name: Place Bet
checks.evidence: MCP builds unsigned tx + simulates (22415 CU). Does NOT auto-sign. External @solana/web3.js signing required. Bet of 0.01 SOL on Yes for market 90 confirmed on-chain at slot 412243463.

checks.name: Check Position
checks.evidence: Position shows 0.02 SOL total (was 0.01 before bet). Bet correctly added to existing position on market 90.

checks.name: Sell Position
checks.evidence: No sell/exit/redeem tools. Only post-resolution claim tools (winnings, refunds). Correctly reflects pari-mutuel model.

checks.name: Balance Roundtrip
checks.evidence: Balance decreased from ~0.12 to ~0.111 SOL after 0.01 SOL bet + fees. MCP has no native balance tool; requires direct Solana RPC.

checks.name: Insufficient Balance
checks.evidence: Two layers: (1) >100 SOL rejected at input validation, (2) 99 SOL (within range, exceeds wallet) caught by simulation with InstructionError Custom(1). Simulation success=false prevents signing.

checks.name: Invalid Inputs
checks.command: 3 tests: amount=0, amount=-1, invalid market ID
checks.evidence: amount=0: 'Amount must be between 0.01 and 100 SOL'. amount=-1: same. Invalid market: 'Market INVALID_MARKET_ID_999999 not found'. All return success:false with descriptive messages.

checks.name: Nonexistent Market
checks.evidence: Clear error for invalid market. Valid Solana address that isn't a market returns valid=false with zeroed fields (soft failure).

checks.name: Recovery
checks.evidence: After all error tests, list_markets returns 15 active markets normally. No state corruption.

betPlaced.question: Will the SEC approve a prediction market ETF before Jun 30, 2026?

keyFindings: MCP does NOT auto-sign transactions. It builds unsigned transactions and returns a signUrl for manual signing. For AI agent use, external Solana signing infrastructure (@solana/web3.js + Keypair) is required.
No native SOL balance query tool. The MCP only tracks platform positions and claimable amounts. Wallet balance requires direct Solana RPC.
No keyword search for markets. Only status and layer filters. Agent must list all markets and filter client-side.
Excellent pari-mutuel pricing tools: get_quote shows expected payout, implied odds, decimal odds, fees, and pool shift. validate_bet adds market state/timing/access validation.
76 tools covering markets, betting, positions, races, affiliates, intel/analytics, and Agent Arena paper trading.
Consistent 22-field schema across all markets. Clean JSON responses with success/error pattern.
BAOZI_LIVE=1 env var required to build transactions (safety gate).
Only 3 of 86 markets have open betting. Most Lab markets have closed or have zero pools.
Two-layer error handling: input validation (amount range, required fields) + Solana simulation (insufficient funds, program errors).
Intel tools (sentiment, whale moves, resolution forecast, market alpha) cost 0.005 SOL each via x402 payment.
blockers: Agent cannot place bets end-to-end via MCP alone — external transaction signing and broadcasting required. This is the single biggest integration gap for autonomous agent operation.
